title: Guinevere
summary: Guinevere was the wife of King Arthur, whom Sir Lancelot fell in love with, ultimately making him unworthy on his quest for the Holy Grail and causing him to fail.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Sir Lancelot left a Ghost Trap with the image of Guinevere in the Mausoleum of Sir Lancelot to guard the entrance to his treasure chamber. [Memory Lane]

Many years later, Lok Lambert and Dante Vale attempted to enter Lancelot's hidden sanctuary. Dante discovered that by kissing the ghostly version of Guinevere's hand, in honor of Lancelot's quest, he was allowed to pass through to the treasure chamber. [Memory Lane]
